headline: Northern Trust Expands U.S. Fund Servicing Capabilities with ETF Platform Launch
summary: CHICAGO, July 28, 2026--Northern Trust has launched its U.S. exchange-traded fund (ETF) servicing platform with its appointment to support a new ETF by Harding Loevner.
